name: 93221 · Exeter, CA
findings: ZIP 93221 (Exeter) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93221 (Exeter) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 93221 (Exeter) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
